name: shared-review
description: Share a prototype or a worker's live app behind sign-in, let several people comment on the spot they mean, and send the comments you choose to Firstmate as one bundle when you close the review.

reviewServer.title: Review server address
reviewServer.description: The public address reviewers open, such as https://review.example.com. Leave it empty to keep reviews on this computer (local previews only).

ownerToken.title: Owner token (vault name)
ownerToken.description: The wh-vault secret that holds the review server's owner token. Grant it to one project; the review desk runs with it to put reviews live and close them.

signIn.title: How reviewers sign in
signIn.description: What a new review offers once it goes live. Local previews always use a passcode.

invite.title: Who may sign in by email
invite.description: Addresses, or @example.com for a whole domain, that new reviews invite. Only for email sign-in.

reviewHost.title: Review host (SSH)
reviewHost.description: Where the docker-over-SSH deploy puts the review server, such as deploy@review-host.example.com. Not needed for Kubernetes or a deploy of your own.

emailFrom.title: Email sender
emailFrom.description: The From address on sign-in links, such as Reviews <reviews@example.com>. Needed only for email sign-in.

smtpUrl.title: Email server (vault name)
smtpUrl.description: The wh-vault secret that holds the SMTP address the review server sends sign-in links through, such as smtps://user:password@smtp.example.com:465.
